```{r setup}
requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)
requireNamespace("scales", quietly = TRUE)
requireNamespace("councilR", quietly = TRUE)
requireNamespace("wesanderson", quietly = TRUE)
library(ghg.sp)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(wesanderson)
library(councilR)

ggplot2::theme_set(
  if(testthat:::on_ci() == TRUE){
    theme_minimal()
  } else {
      councilR::theme_council(use_showtext = T,
                          use_manual_font_sizes = T)
  }
)


st_paul_pass <- transportation_data$passenger %>%
  filter(
    ctu %in% c(
      "St. Paul",
      "All"
    ),
    # !year %in% c("2045", "2050")
  )
st_paul_freight <- transportation_data$freight %>%
  filter(
    ctu %in% c(
      "St. Paul",
      "All"
    ),
    # !year %in% c("2045","2050")
  )
```


```{r}
st_paul_pass %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(var, "Sales"),
    mode == "PLDV",
    var != "TotSales"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year,
    y = value,
    color = var,
    fill = var,
    group = var
  )) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Powertrain",
    values = wesanderson::wes_palettes$Royal2,
    aesthetics = c("fill", "color"),
    labels = c(
      "BEVSales" = "Electric",
      "CISales" = "Diesel",
      "HEVSales" = "Hybrid",
      "PHEVSales" = "Plug-in hybrid",
      "SISales" = "Gasoline"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Passenger personal vehicle sales",
       subtitle = "Business as usual")
```



```{r}
adj_sales <- adj_fleet_shares(
  .pass_tb = st_paul_pass,
  .freight_tb = st_paul_freight,
  .bev_pct_sales = 0.4854,
  .hev_pct_sales = 0.1352,
  .phev_pct_sales = 0.3151
)
```
```{r}
adj_sales$pass %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(var, "Sales"),
    mode == "PLDV",
    var != "TotSales"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

    )
  ) +

```
